ui.options.beammp.protectConfigFromClone: Protect this config from being cloned by other players.
ui.options.beammp.enableNewChatMenu.tool: The new chat menu uses ImGui. It's customisable, sleek and awesome!
ui.options.beammp.enablePosSmoother.tool: Tries to smooth position data from players with unstable connections, reducing vehicle warping/rubber banding
ui.options.beammp.autoSyncVehicles.toolt: If enabled, your vehicle parts will automatically be synced to other players after a few seconds
ui.options.beammp.queueSpawnEdit.tooltip: If enabled, remote vehicle spawns and edits will be put in a queue, instead of applying instantly
ui.options.beammp.queueAuto.tooltip: If enabled, you will only spawn queued vehicles once you come to a stop based on the settings below
ui.options.beammp.highlightQueuedPlayers: Highlight players who have queued events in the playerlist
ui.options.beammp.playerlistLeftclick.to: Choose what happens when you left click on a player name in the playerlist
ui.options.beammp.queueApplySpeed.toolti: Queues apply if your vehicle moves slower than this speed
ui.options.beammp.queueApplyTimeout.tool: Queues apply if your vehicle moves under your set speed threshold for this long
ui.options.beammp.queueAutoSkipRemote.to: If enabled and spectating other players, you will spawn queued vehicles right away
ui.options.beammp.queueSkipUnicycle.tool: If enabled, you will spawn other Unicycles (Snowmen/Beamlings) right away
ui.options.beammp.luaOptimisations.toolt: If enabled, other vehicles will run limited Lua calculations, improving performance
ui.options.beammp.debugOutput: Show network activity in the console
ui.options.beammp.launcherPort: Launcher port:[br]Don't change unless you have to
ui.options.beammp.launcherPortWarn: Don't change unless you have to
ui.options.beammp.launcherPort.tooltip: Set this to the custom port that the launcher was set to use.
ui.options.beammp.clearLauncherCache.too: Enabling this will clear the currently download mod cache of the launcher. Doing this will result in you having to download all mods for each server you join again.
ui.options.beammp.skipOtherPlayersVehicl: Disable switching to other players vehicles
ui.options.beammp.fadeVehicles: Fade out vehicles as they get closer
ui.options.beammp.fadeVehicles.tooltip: Good when paired with disabled collisions
ui.options.beammp.showPlayerIDs.tooltip: Enable to show player ID's in the player list.
ui.options.beammp.disableLuaReload: Disable Lua reloading when quitting a multiplayer server.
ui.options.beammp.disableLuaReload.toolt: Lua reloads are required to ensure that the game is put back to a working state if mods had replaced game functions. Can be disabled for a smoother experience at your own risk.
ui.options.beammp.disableInstabilityPaus: This will make gameplay smoother but can cause sync issues after several instabilities
ui.options.beammp.simplifyRemoteVehicles: This setting will replace remote vehicles with the BeamNG provided 'traffic' versions. Reduces accuracy of collisions and visuals, but improves performance
ui.options.beammp.enableBlobs.tooltip: Unspawned vehicles will appear as colored spheres (blobs)
ui.options.beammp.showSpectators: Show spectators' nametag under vehicle nametags
ui.options.beammp.showSpectators.tooltip: Players spectating others' vehicles will be listed under their nametags
ui.options.beammp.licensePlateUsesPlayer: Show Player names on license plates
Will show the Player's username on vehicle license plates
ui.options.beammp.spectatorUnifiedColors: Draw all spectator nametags as grey, independent of the user's role
ui.options.beammp.nametagFadeDistance.to: How far nametags will start fading in/stop fading out
ui.options.beammp.nametagCharLimit.toolt: Maximum number of characters you want to see in a nametag
ui.options.beammp.shortenNametags.toolti: Trim long player names and roles
ui.options.beammp.unicycleAutoSave: Automatically save your last used Unicycle
ui.options.beammp.unicycleAutoSave.toolt: When you despawn your Unicycle, it is saved and reused next time you spawn it
ui.options.beammp.skipModSecurityWarning: Skip the mod security warning popup
Disable the security popup when joining modded servers.
ui.options.beammp.refreshIngame: Allow the serverlist to refresh ingame
ui.options.beammp.refreshIngame.tooltip: Whether to allow the server list to refresh whilst in a session. Enabling this can cause lag spikes.
ui.options.beammp.useUiAppRedesign.toolt: Choose the visual style for BeamMP's HUD apps.
